notes.title: Balancing and Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
Remote Play compatibility has been added
 Shoulder buttons on gamepad now control weapon slots (press either to switch, or both simultaneously to link weapons.)
 Reduced "Slice-N-Dice" achievement count for completion
 Fixed a few levels in which the player could get stuck
 Removed weapon upgrade from level 2-4
 Switched spike position in level 3-7 to help prevent player self-destruct
 Balanced Item/Shield/Weapon drop rate
 Corrected some messaging typos
 Shortened timer on title screen before story auto plays
 Player 1 is now always controlled by gamepad 1 and player 2 by gamepad 2
 Fixed error causing menus to freeze if player 2's controller connected during gameplay.
 Enemies now drop energy even if the player's energy bar is full
 Fixed glitch causing Areas to relock after completion if the player went back to an earlier area and beat the boss.
 Increased check timer when controllers are unplugged/plugged in to help lag error in steam connected controllers (recommend direct connected Xbox controllers for best experience)
 Fixed error causing enemies to never drop items in the level editor if the last area played was the tutorial.
